candidates.change_summary: Remove the 'if(intitalized)revert();' guard so SetMinSum can be called multiple times, changing MinSum after first call.
Change assignment to MinSum = _val + 1 so stored value differs.
Insert a constant addition before the guard so MinSum becomes _val + 10.
Delete the MinSum = _val; statement so MinSum remains 0.
Replace MinSum = _val with MinSum = 0 so MinSum is always zero after call.
Replace MinSum = _val with MinSum = 1 ether so MinSum is fixed to 1 ether.
Move MinSum = _val before the guard so MinSum updates even after initialization.
Remove the if(intitalized)revert() guard so SetMinSum can be called multiple times, changing MinSum after initialization.
Delete the assignment so SetMinSum does not update MinSum.
Replace MinSum assignment with a constant, ignoring the input parameter.
Remove the if(intitalized)revert(); check so SetLogFile can be called multiple times, overwriting the Log variable after initialization.
Delete the overflow check for acc.balance + msg.value so overflow can silently occur, altering the recorded balance.
Replace `acc.balance += msg.value` with `acc.balance = msg.value` so the balance is overwritten instead of accumulated.
Replace the unlock time update condition to always overwrite unlockTime with the new lock time regardless of which is larger.
Replace `block.timestamp + _lockTime` with `block.timestamp` in the unlock time update so the unlock time is always set to the current block timestamp.
Delete the Log.AddMessage call so the Put event is no longer recorded in the Log contract.
Replace `msg.sender` with `address(0)` in the Log.AddMessage call so the sender recorded is always zero address.
Replace `msg.value` with `0` in the Log.AddMessage call so the recorded value is always zero.
Delete the unlock time update condition block so that unlockTime is never extended by Put.
Replace the overflow check with a tautology `true` so overflow can silently occur, altering the recorded balance.
Replace `acc.balance += msg.value` with `acc.balance -= msg.value` so the balance is decreased instead of increased.
